nvitk.pipes.qvtpy¶

Python-native QVT+ cerebrovascular pipeline (qvtpy).

Orchestrates DICOM acquisition, NIfTI conversion, eICAB CoW segmentation, 4D-flow registration, centerline extraction, local complex-difference segmentation, LOC placement, and phase-based hemodynamics. Entry points:

  • nvitk.pipes.qvtpy.run — master CLI nvitk-qvtpy (local or SGE).

  • nvitk.pipes.qvtpy.run_flowshow — interactive 4D-flow viewer nvitk-qvtpy-flowshow.

  • nvitk.pipes.qvtpy.config — host paths, stage directory names, cluster defaults.

  • nvitk.pipes.qvtpy.labels — eICAB vs qvtpy multilabel id tables.

Per-subject results live under <output_root>/<subject>/qvtpy/<stage_dir>/ (see QVT_SUBDIR and STAGE*_DIR constants).
